overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Weston Community Development Authority was scheduled to meet on July 27, 2026 to consider approval of a resolution authorizing the redemption of community development lease revenue bonds and to receive updates on two Tax Increment Finance districts. The meeting was also set to approve minutes from a previous meeting.

agenda.item: Approval of Minutes from Previous CDA Meeting: March 10, 2020
Approval of the Resolution Authorizing the Redemption of the Community Development lease revenue bonds, series 2017a, dated July 13, 2017

discussions.body: The Authority was scheduled to receive an update on Tax Increment Finance District #1. This update was expected to provide information on the current status and activities within the TIF district.
The Authority was scheduled to receive an update on Tax Increment Finance District #2. This update was expected to provide information on the current status and activities within the TIF district.

discussions.item: Approval of the Resolution Authorizing the Redemption of the Community Development lease revenue bonds, series 2017a, dated July 13, 2017
discussions.body: The Authority was set to consider approval of a resolution authorizing the redemption of community development lease revenue bonds issued on July 13, 2017. This action was expected to address the retirement or refinancing of outstanding CDA debt.

actionItems: Scheduled to approve minutes from March 10, 2020 CDA meeting
Expected to vote on Resolution Authorizing the Redemption of Community Development lease revenue bonds, series 2017a
title: Community Development Authority - 7/27/2026
